status: PROPOSED - the approved Architecture Baseline dependency matrix is not committed yet
description: Centralised, explicit dependency allowlist. Default is deny; each entry needs an ADR, so do not add entries to make a check pass. moduleDependencies: module-to-module edges through published public entrypoints. contextInfrastructure: per module, the Global Infrastructure workspace packages and persistence npm packages that modules/<context>/src/infrastructure/** may use. Source-path restrictions always apply on top of this list. compositionRoots: per module, the application packages and source paths allowed to import that module's `@sdris/<context>/composition` entrypoint (default: none). testOnlyEntrypoints: per package, exported subpaths that only recognised test files (and any approvedPaths) may import; the directory behind such an entrypoint is protected too.
